description: Use when you need Unix timestamps as dates. Converts one or more timestamps, seconds or milliseconds, one per line, to UTC dates in ISO 8601 as a CSV. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

text.description: One or more Unix timestamps, one per line: whole seconds or milliseconds, digits with an optional leading minus, inside the years 0001 to 9999. At most 1,048,576 bytes of UTF-8 and 10,000 lines; a line break at the very end is not a line.

name: convert-unix-timestamp-to-date
title: Convert Unix timestamp to date
